newsitem.title: THAILAND: Four Thais killed after fire rases house.
newsitem.headline: Four Thais killed after fire rases house.

text.p: Four members of a Thai family died and one was seriously injured in the eastern resort town of Pattaya after fire rased their three-storey shop house before dawn on Sunday, police said.
All the victims were asleep when the blaze broke out, they told Reuters.
Firefighters spent about half an hour putting out the fire and later recovered the charred bodies of the victims.
Police said they were investigating the cause of the fire, believed to have started in the second floor of the building. No further details were available.
